sentences.en: The author translated the fairy tale into our mother tongue.
sentences.zh: 作者把这个童话翻译成了我们的母语。

sentences.en: I think this novel shows the author at his best.
sentences.zh: 我认为这部小说展现了作者的最佳状态。

sentences.en: The author illustrated his book with a lot of pictures.
sentences.zh: 作者在他的书中用了很多插图来说明。
